content.text: {"affected_statement":"L6.2","objection_correct":"yes","established_elsewhere":"no","elsewhere_quote":null,"status_as_written":"not_established","repair_distance":"symbol","explanation":"As defined, Q contains only prime divisors of A, not every prime at most A. Thus both assertions identified in the objection are false, and they are essential to the induction proving large-prime erasure. The later discussion notices that all primes at most A are required but does not redefine Q or supply a valid alternative proof. Replacing the definition of Q by {p prime : p≤A} makes the displayed induction work."}
